gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Expressive is the word for Warnes, whose ink strokes taper out before touching, while Noto Sans Palmyrene lets its curves stop short. Let the heading go big and the body stay modest.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Bold Warnes spaces its letters wide, with ink strokes that taper out before they touch. Noto Sans Tai Tham, meanwhile, does the humbler job, packing chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-thai: Warnes draws ink strokes that taper out before they touch. It handles the loud display work, while Noto Sans Thai takes the quieter job with swollen, glass-bead lowercase and rounded letters left open.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Warnes strokes look like thread stitched along a path. That makes it the showy half, while Noto Sans Wancho brings a hulking, chalky lowercase and an e with a wide gap.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout and stays crisp when shrunk, a sturdy foil for Warnes, whose ink strokes taper out. Let the body text go small without worry.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-pathway-extreme: Expressive Warnes stretches its tapering ink strokes wide, while Pathway Extreme tucks stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height. One shouts a little, the other keeps compact and modern.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Dark and aggressive: that is Eater, with wide gaps between letters. Noto Sans Soyombo sits beneath it with a sizable x-height and wide, unclosed curves, so the page moves from menace to clear reading.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase. Below the tall, sturdy lowercase of Irish Grover, paragraphs would flow smoothly, the body's open letter mouths keeping each line clear.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Irish Grover makes words look sturdy, large and tall, with open throats. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki does the gentler work, its tightly coiled, rope-like lowercase and open apertures keeping text easy going.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Fun and organic, Irish Grover leans tall and sturdy, while Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away before curves close. One brings the swagger, the other keeps the text moving.
